title: Recommendations and broad praise
summary: This topic centers on customers saying they would tell others about the dealer or praising the vehicle’s appearance, while several fragments are too vague or contextual to classify clearly.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention recommending the dealer to others and saying people like the vehicle’s looks.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments include incomplete or context-light mentions of 'everyone,' dealership mention without clear evaluation, and a speculative comment about over-the-air updates.

limitations: The topic appears to mix dealer recommendation, vehicle appearance, and over-the-air update commentary rather than one tightly unified subject.
Most examples are very short, so the intent and sentiment are unclear in several fragments.
These samples are stratified and limited in size, so they do not indicate how common these views are beyond the provided reviews.
